enable1.txt.title: ENABLE (172k words)
enable1.txt.description: Huge, permissive public-domain list. Pros: almost anything reasonable plays. Cons: includes obscure junk; little curation.

tournament_american.txt.title: Tournament American (24k words)
tournament_american.txt.description: Curated 6of12 list. Pros: clean everyday vocabulary. Cons: misses many inflections; includes some 2-letter jargon unless strict mode is on.

extended_american.txt.title: Extended American (75k words)
extended_american.txt.description: 2of12inf with inflections. Pros: balanced size and coverage. Cons: middle-ground curation.

international_game.txt.title: International Game (61k words)
international_game.txt.description: Collins-style game word list. Pros: world-tournament feel. Cons: accepts some words American players will contest.

arcane_lexicon.txt.title: Arcane Lexicon (145 words)
arcane_lexicon.txt.description: Bonus word file: fantasy flavor words. Playing them triggers an Arcane Surge (+25 each). Pros: thematic spice when merged. Cons: far too small alone.

common_english.txt.title: Common English (2.1k words)
common_english.txt.description: Casual/family mode: small everyday vocabulary, playable entirely on its own for relaxed games. Foundation of the two-letter whitelist. Off by default - enable alongside big grimoires only for flavor.

acronyms.txt.title: Acronyms & Initialisms
acronyms.txt.description: Opt-in modern abbreviations (NASA, GIF, YOLO). Pros: fun wildcard vocabulary. Cons: purists will object; enable per game mode as desired.

pirate_pillage.txt.title: Pirate Pillage (55 words)
pirate_pillage.txt.description: Bonus file: swashbuckling vocabulary. Playing these words triggers a surge (+25 each). Yo ho.

medieval_might.txt.title: Medieval Might (50 words)
medieval_might.txt.description: Bonus file: knights, sieges and heraldry. Playing these words triggers a surge (+25 each).

gothic_grimoire.txt.title: Gothic Grimoire (47 words)
gothic_grimoire.txt.description: Bonus file: haunted horror vocabulary. Playing these words triggers a surge (+30 each). Best played by candlelight.

cosmic_canticle.txt.title: Cosmic Canticle (31 words)
cosmic_canticle.txt.description: Bonus file: starfaring vocabulary. Rarer words, richer reward (+40 each).

kitchen_witchery.txt.title: Kitchen Witchery (31 words)
kitchen_witchery.txt.description: Bonus file: hearth-craft and cookery. Gentle surges (+15 each). Cozy mode.

two_letter_whitelist.txt.title: Two-Letter Whitelist
two_letter_whitelist.txt.description: Trusted two-letter words used by the 'strict two-letter' ruleset toggle. Not playable on its own.
